scope: ESS-RS Appendix2 source catalogue; no operational command support or hardware qualification

qualification.firmware: unverified; model scope comes from vendor-linked hardware manual

global_notes: Every register is 16 bits; paired records occupy two successive registers. Width does not settle signed encoding or range.
Source RW/S notation is preserved; no automatic persistence or save semantics inferred. RW persistence likewise unspecified.
All source defaults are metadata, not detected current values or library initialization writes.
Undocumented address holes are not labelled reserved: only the 16 position-segment reserved words are explicitly reserved.
Signed semantic values do not establish negative wire encoding. No setters/value acceptance functions are supplied.
Source catalogue completeness is independent from resolved semantics, implemented operations and hardware qualification.
Source text spacing is normalized for readability; contradictory numeric values and malformed ranges are retained and labelled.

registers.name: ERROR_CODE

registers.name: INPUT_STATUS

registers.name: OUTPUT_STATUS

registers.name: CURRENT_POSITION

registers.name: CURRENT_SPEED

registers.name: SUBDIVISION

registers.name: CUSTOM_NODE

registers.name: ENCODER_RESOLUTION

indexed_groups.notes: Execution is external-input-triggered only; PIN0-PIN3 choose 1-16. Four-input devices can choose at most 8 while reserving an input for trigger. Selection stable 5 ms before/after PT trigger.

indexed_groups.name: SPEED_SEGMENT
indexed_groups.notes: Execution is external-input-triggered only; four-input devices limited to 8 externally selected segments, despite 16 stored parameter sets.

indexed_groups.name: SEGMENT_START_SPEED
indexed_groups.notes: Shared by PT and PV modes. Range row applies all 16 addresses.
